blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The 2026-27 NBA regular season continued Friday, October 30 (October 31 in the Philippines), with a three-game slate headlined by the Atlanta Hawks, New Orleans Pelicans and Memphis Grizzlies. Atlanta Hawks beat Cleveland Cavaliers, 114-111 Onyeka Okongwu scored a season-high 29 points and had 12 rebounds, while Nickeil Alexander-Walker added 25 points and Aaron Wiggins scored 20 off the bench for Atlanta. James Harden led Cleveland with 24 points, while Donovan Mitchell added 22. Atlanta snapped a three-game losing streak to improve to 3-3, while Cleveland’s three-game winning streak ended.
